answer: A reputation-weighted staking ledger can bind each worker identity to a costly bond, so a sybil cluster must post capital proportional to its claimed skill tier rather than spawning free accounts. Each raven-like infiltrator is forced into a costly spiral of repeated bonding, while a mirror audit compares its attested task history against peer endorsements to expose. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
